scope: Every actual finite-field tower F⊆K⊆B with B any field extension, explicit compatible algebra/scalar-tower data, every general Weierstrass model WoverF: actual point PoverB comes from actual W(K) iff [K:F]iterations of actual F-Frobenius fix P. Same equivalence for every actual r-torsion set. Actual |K|=|F|^[K:F]proved, and explicit kforms derived from |K|=|F|^k. Chosen embedded finite extension, not a construction of a canonical subfield in a fixed closure. Geometric torsion rank/determinant and Weil necessity remain open for qualified BK.
statement: For every actual finite-field tower F⊆K⊆B with compatible embeddings and B any field extension, every general Weierstrass model WoverF and every actual point PoverB, P lies in the actual image of W(K) iff [K:F]iterations of actual F-Frobenius fix P. The same binding proves the entire actual r-torsion set criterion for every natural r, actual |K|=|F|^[K:F], and explicit kforms derived from |K|=|F|^k. No abstract rationality predicate, torsion basis or intended fixedness conclusion is assumed.
